body: Is there anything I can do to help here?
If you could assemble a small reproducer, that would be helpful.

Here you go: https://github.com/andlinger/quarkus-native-locales

The [TranslationResource](https://github.com/andlinger/quarkus-native-locales/blob/main/quarkus/src/main/java/io/i15s/quarkus/TranslationResource.java) resource http://localhost:8080/translation returns the following in JVM mode:

```json
{
  "en": "France",
  "it": "Francia"
}
```

Result in native mode:
```json
{
  "en": "France",
  "it": "France"
}
```
@zakkak @Karm could one of you have a look at the reproducer?
I will take a look as I have some Language setting test and this should be a part of it...

I think this is something we do in Quarkus with passing locale names. As you can see, a plain reproducer without Quarkus is sensitive to how locales are parsed:

```java
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class Main {
    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(Main.class.getName());

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.printf("English: %s\n", Locale.FRANCE.getDisplayCountry(Locale.ENGLISH));
        System.out.printf("German: %s\n", Locale.FRANCE.getDisplayCountry(Locale.GERMAN));
        System.out.printf("Italian: %s\n", Locale.FRANCE.getDisplayCountry(Locale.ITALIAN));
    }
}
```

```bash
$ java --version
openjdk 17.0.1 2021-10-19
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-17.0.1+12 (build 17.0.1+12)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-17.0.1+12 (build 17.0.1+12, mixed mode, sharing)
```

```bash
$ native-image --version
native-image 21.3.0.0-Final Mandrel Distribution (Java Version 17.0.1+12)
```

# Good :heavy_check_mark: 

```
$ javac Main.java
$ native-image --no-fallback --initialize-at-build-time= -H:IncludeResourceBundles=sun.util.resources.LocaleNames -H:IncludeLocales=fr,en,it,de Main
$ ./main 
English: France
German: Frankreich
Italian: Francia

$ java Main
English: France
German: Frankreich
Italian: Francia

```

# Bad

```
$ native-image --no-fallback --initialize-at-build-time= -H:IncludeResourceBundles=sun.util.resources.LocaleNames -H:IncludeLocales=fr_FR,en_US,it_IT,de_DE Main
$ ./main 
English: France
German: France
Italian: France
```

I will take a look further and fix
@Karm Any news on this? Is there anything I can help you with?
@andlinger No news. I shall circle back to it shortly and post an update :+1:

```
quarkus.native.auto-service-loader-registration=true
```
Registers LocaleData service loader providers and makes it work as expected. Yet it's a crude hammer. I would like to have something fine grained to just bake in those that are needed...so WIP.
Thanks for the info. So there is currently no way to register specific service loaders manually?
@andlinger It is, programmatically, on the Quarkus side. Not via config/user app code to my best knowledge though. I will keep tinkering with it to have a such switch for Locales.
